ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel field with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; approximately 15% high-intensity to 85% low-intensity ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark contiguous base across both lobes with high-contrast white punctate blobs, ring-shaped scars, and linear marks. Dense high-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips (left and right margins).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a pixel angle of approximately 88 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations. Significant jagged indentations and missing tissue segments observed on both lobes, with more frequent peaks and valleys on the image-left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep of the trailing edges with a slight upward curvature toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular (ring-shaped) white pixel clusters ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter, distributed across the central and outer fluke regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths, including a prominent diagonal line on the inner right lobe and multiple horizontal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jaggedness and irregularity of the trailing edge suggesting substantial historical tissue loss. Heavy white scarring/encrustation at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of unique bullseye-patterned circular scars (white ring with dark center) throughout the ventral surface.
